channel.name: ORU R01 to Two Lab Bundles
channel.description: An ORU^R01 builds laboratory resources once and adds them to two Bundles: labo-transaction (FHIR Server, HTTP response on /labo/, 10803) and labo-document (bundleDocument variable). Two parallel branches: the FHIR server, and the document repository followed by PCA/PRA archiving, which archives only accepted documents (files in appdata/archive-pca). Shared identities and references; requests only in the transaction.
